obligations.source_text: Photorealistic identity-preserving facial edit of the supplied adult fictional nurse scene. Preserve the reference woman's pale oval face, ash-blonde hair, gray eyes, and natural adult facial geometry, and keep the uniform, capped syringe, palm pinning the same adult patient's call button on the far trolley, reaching fingers, visible gap, cable, camera, and clinical background unchanged. Her small closed-lip asymmetric smile remains genuinely tender, one corner barely higher with faint natural flush. Both eyes stay precisely fixed on the same adult patient: pale matte low-contrast gray irises, one tiny dim scene-coherent catchlight per eye, slightly elevated upper lids, taut lower lids, and an almost motionless brow form an unnervingly overfocused stare. As the patient reaches for the call button, her smile deepens by a fraction while her eyes remain unchanged; the reaching adult patient's fingers remain separated from the button by a visible gap. Her nearly upright head, affectionate mouth, frozen target-lock, controlling palm, and visible consequence coexist in the same instant.
